description: Poll the status of an engagement you opened with engage_sasame, and READ the human operator's reply — entirely over MCP, no email needed. Pass the `ticket` you got back from engage_sasame. Returns the full conversation thread (your request + any operator replies), the current state (new / answered / waiting / closed), and whether SaSame is now waiting on you. Call this again periodically (e.g. once a day) to pick up the operator's response. Free, read-only, deterministic — no LLM, no network.

ticket.description: The engagement ticket returned by engage_sasame (e.g. 'inq_...').

name: check_engagement
